title.narrative: Reconversin y Desarrollo de la Granja

description.narrative: THIS PROGRAM AIMS TO INCREASE THE VALUE AND QUALITY OF THE PRODUCTION OF THE FARM SUBSECTOR (FRUITS AND VEGETABLES, HOG AND APICULTURE PRODUCTION) AND OF ITS EXPORTS WITHIN MERCOSUR, AND THE INCOME OF ITS PRODUCERS, THROUGH INVESTMENTS THAT IMPROVE ITS COMPETITIVENESS AND FINANCE THE FOLLOWING ACTIVITIES: 1) TECHNOLOGICAL DEVELOPMENT; 2) QUALITY CONTROL; 3) COMMERCIAL DEVELOPMENT AND 4) INSTITUTIONAL STRENGTHENING.
